company.name: The Exploration Company
company.shortDescription: The Exploration Company develops space transportation systems, including reusable spacecraft and rocket propulsion technologies.
company.description: The Exploration Company develops space transportation systems, including reusable spacecraft and rocket propulsion technologies. Its Nyx spacecraft is designed for transportation between Earth and low Earth orbit stations, with capabilities covering orbital propulsion, docking, navigation, flight software, re-entry, and recovery. The company also develops Storm, a reusable high-thrust rocket engine intended to power orbital launch vehicles. Its technology portfolio supports missions involving space stations, cargo transportation, orbital operations, and the broader space transportation sector. The Exploration Company combines spacecraft, propulsion, avionics, software, and recovery systems within an integrated space transportation platform.

productsAndServices.description: A modular, reusable, and in-orbit refillable space vehicle designed to transport cargo to and from space stations in low-Earth orbit and beyond.
